escena: SCENE (documentary, client's boardroom late in the evening, the first-month results): an Efeonce account lead in the navy Efeonce softshell jacket over the navy polo holding a plain azure-blue (#0375DB) clicker, stands at a large wall screen and points at the moment a rising line crosses the target mark, caught mid-gesture as she turns her head toward the two clients seated in the dark foreground; nobody looks at the lens. The wall screen is the brightest thing in the frame and lights her face and hand in cool white-blue. The screen shows only a soft abstract rising line, no readable text or numbers. The dark ceiling and wall above the screen are calm and evenly shadowed. 35mm f/2.

lecho.objeto: the dark shoulder and back of a seated client right at the lens, dissolved into blur

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed dark wall and ceiling above the screen
